mnan pa khyed kyi gzhung*/khungs ma rnams nas bshad pa med/ /mu stegs mnan pa nged kyi rgyud/ /gdod ma nyid nas yod pa yin/ /des na nged kyi rang bzo

tei:div.tei:p: mnan pa khyed kyi gzhung*/ khungs ma rnams nas bshad pa med/ /mu stegs mnan pa nged kyi rgyud/ /gdod ma nyid nas yod pa yin/ /des na nged kyi rang bzo min

| | de nas spobs pa med gyur tshe/ /rgyal po khyod kyi yul 'di ru/ /'di 'dra'i rang bzo 'phel na ni/ /da dung rang bzo gzhan 'byung bas/ /bstan pa spyi la gnod pa 'di/ kho rang la yang cis mi gnod/ /'di 'dra'i rang bzo'i chos lugs ni/ /sangs rgyas pa la byung na yang*/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dgag dgos so | | de skad bsgo nas gyeng ris bsubs/ /phyi nas grub mtha' brtsad pa la'ang*/ /mu stegs grub mtha' pham mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel zhes thos/ /gal te mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung*/ /gdod nas grub pa'i rig byed las | | chos log de 'dra bshad na yang*/ /rang bzo yin zhes byar mi rung*/ / grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bzung nas ni/ /rigs pa gzhan gyis sun dbyung dgos | | bdag dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la'ang*/ /gal te 'gal ba snang na ni | | rigs pa dag dang 'gal gyur na/ /de ni rigs pas sun phyung shig /gal te lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /de ni legs par sun 'byin pa'i/ /gdams ngag cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /pha rol lung de khas len cing*/ /de dang 'gal ba'i chos spyod na//lung dang 'gal bas sun dbyung bya/ /gal te lung de khas mi len// rang gi lung gzhan khas len na/ /de tshe nged kyi lung gis ni/ /dai yi chos log dgag mi nus/ /'on kyang de yi lung nyid kyis/ /de yi chos log dgag dgos so | | dper na pha rol phyin pa la/ /gal te chos log spyod na ni/ /gsang sngags gzhung dang 'gal lo zhes/ /de ni sun dbyung nus ma yin/ /de bzhin gsang sngags pa 'ga' zhig /lag len log par spyod gyur kyang*/ /pha rol phyin gzhung dang 'gal zhes/ /sun dbyung bar ni nus ma yin/ /de ltar theg pa che chung la'ang | | phan tshun gyi ni lung 'gal gyis/ /so so'i gzhung lugs dgag mi nus || nyan thos gzhung lugs khas len cing*/ /de yi lung dang 'gal gyur na/ / de yi lung gis dgag par nus/ /de bzhin bka' gdams la sogs kyang*/

/ jo bo'i gzhung lugs khas len cing*/ /de yi lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /bka' gdams pa la gnod pa yin/ /de bzhin phyag rgya pa yang ni/ /nā ro pa la mos byed cing*/ /nā ro'i gzhung dang 'gal gyur na/ /phyag rgya pa la gnod pa yin/ / de bzhin gsang sngags spyod bzhin du/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde dang 'gal na/ / gsang sngags pa la gnod par 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lugs byed cing*/ / mdo sde rnams dang 'gal gyur na/ /phar phyin pa la cis mi gnod/ /de yi dpe brjod mdo tsam zhig /legs par bshad kyis mnyan par gyis/ /jo bo gsang sngags spyod bzhin du/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus min zhes/ /smra ba jo bo'i lugs nyid dang*/ /'gal ba yin par shes par bya/ /sems bskyed jo bo'i lugs byed cing*/ /jo bo gtan nas mi bzhed pa'i/ /sems bskyed kun la byed pa dang*/ /don dam sems bskyed byed pa ni/ /gzhan dang 'gal pa smos ci dgos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /nā ro ta pa dbang bskur dang*/ / rim gnyis chos kyi gtso bor mdzad/ /nā ro'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi bsgom pa/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs ni//mar pa lho brag pa la med// mar pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /phag mos chos sgo 'byed pa ni/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid/ /mi la yan chad de las med/ /chos drug bor nas lam 'bras dang | | phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa/ /gzhan gyi gdams ngag bsgom bzhin du | | nā ro'i brgyud pa 'ded byed pa/ /gzhan dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /gter nas byung ba'i glegs bam dang*/ / gzhan nas brkus pa'i chos lugs dang*/ /brtsams chos dang ni rmi lam chos/ / blo bzung ma yi chos lugs la/ /rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa snyeg

/de la'ang gzhan dag lung len pa/ /chos dang 'gal ba smos ci dgos/ /rang tshig dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i rigs can gyi/ /'gal ba khas len snang gyur na/ /de yi rigs su shes par bya/ /mdor na chos dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos zhig gang na 'dug na yang*/ /lung dang rigs pas sun phyung shig /gal te mu stegs la sogs pa/ /lung de khas mi len pa dang*/ /lung dang 'gal yang nged cag gi bla ma'i bka' srol yin zer ba/ /de dag lung de mi len yang*/ /rtsa ba'i brgyud pa gang yin dri/ /gdod nas chos de yod na ni/ /'khrul yang mkhas pas bgrang rgyu med/ /sems can las ngan spyod pa la/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ci byar yod | | gal te gdod nas med pa'i chos/ /glo bur byas pa yin na ni/ /kun gyis rang bzor go ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas pa'am mu stegs byed/ /su la 'dug kyang dor bya yin/ /nged la'ang de 'dra 'dug na ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad gyis/ /gal te rgyal po'i khrims yod na/ /chad pas bcad pa'i 'os yin no || nor la zog tshong byas pa la/ /rgyal po'i khrims la thug gyur na/ /chos log brdzun mas sbyar ba la'ang*/ /rgyal po'i khrims la cis mi thug /blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga'/ /lung gi gnas skabs mi shes par/ /mdo rgyud lung sbyor byed mod kyi/ /de ni blun po'i kha shags ltar/ /gang du 'gro ba mi shes so/ / dper na phyag dang mchod pa dang*/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs m-i dgos/ / sems bskyed dbang bskur bya mi dgos/ /bsam gtan klog pa 'dir mi dgos | | dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka med/ /sangs rgyas sems can yod med sogs | | 'di 'dra gsungs pa'i lung rnams kun/ /lta ba yin gyi bsgom pa dang | | spyod pa gnyis kyi lung ma yin/ /dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /cho ga 'khrugs na las mi 'chags/ /log par spyad na ltung ba 'byung*/ /lha bsgom 'khrul na byin mi rlob/ /the tshom za na nyes pa skye/

/des na cho ga ci byed kyang*/ / shin tu dag par bya dgos zhes/ /de 'dra'i lung kun spyod pa dang*/ /bsgom pa yin gyi lta ba min/ /gzhan yang lung sbyor byed pa la/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i gnas skabs rnam gnyis yod/ /dbang dang dam tshig sdom pa sogs/ /'bad nas bsgrub par gsungs pa ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma brgal ba'i/ /'jig rten pa la gsungs pa yin/ /dbang dang dam tshig sogs mi dgos/ /phyag dang mchod pa kun las grol/ /bsam gtan bsgom pa kun spangs te/ /lam kun gzings bzhin dor bya zhes/ /gsungs pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal ba'i gang zag rnams la gsungs/ /de 'dra'i gnas skabs shes nas ni/ /de dang 'tsham pa'i lung sbyor bya/ /de 'dra'i rnam gzhag mi shes pa'i | | lung sbyor mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /mig ldan ji ltar lam nor yang | | g.yang sar gom pa 'jog mi srid/ /de bzhin mkhas pa 'khrul na yang || sangs rgyas bstan las 'da' mi nus/ /mig med gal te lam nor na/ / g.yang sar mchongs nas ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin blun po 'khrul gyur na/ / sangs rgyas bstan las 'das te ltung*/ /chag tshad shes pa'i bzo la ni/ /ring thung byung yang sor gang yin/ /chag tshad med pa'i bzo 'ga' zhig /nyes na bzhad gad gnas su 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhung lugs shes pa'i mi/ /'khrul yang tshig don cung zad yin/ /gzhung lugs gang yang mi shes pa/ /'khrul na bstan pa 'jig la thub/ /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin/ /bsgrub par 'dod na gzhung bzhin bya/ /mig mangs rgya dang ma 'brel na/ /rde'u mang yang shi ro yin/ /de bzhin khungs dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /chos lugs mang yang ro dang 'dra | | snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du/ /grags pa'i chos lugs mang po yod || rgyud dang mthun na blang du rung*/ /min na brdzun gyi bsdeb phyogs yin/ / rmi lam gyi ni chos lugs dang*/ /zhal mthong gi ni lha la sogs/ /'di dag mdo rgyud dang mthun na/

/blangs kyang skyon du 'gyur ba med/ /mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun na/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin zhes bya/ /bla ma'ang mdo rgyud dang mthun na | | de ni bla ma yin par gzung*/ /sangs rgyas bstan bzhin mi gsungs na/ / bla ma yin yang btang snyoms bzhag /des na rmi lam chos lugs dang*/ /zhal gzigs pa yi yi dam dang*/ /lung bstan mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /bla ma'i gsung sgros la sogs pa/ /ma dpyad par ni gtam chol du/ /tshad ma yin zhes gzung mi bya/ /'di 'dra bdud kyi byin rlabs las/ /'byung ba srid par rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa mchog /nges don tshad ma yin par gzung | | yang na dngos po stobs zhugs kyi/ /rigs pas grub pa tshad mar gzung | | skyes bu brdzun mas sbyar ba yi/ /mdo rgyud tshad mar gzung mi bya/ / ko'u shi ka'i mdo dang ni/ /de bzhin 'phags pa shig can dang*/ /blo gros bzang mo chung ngu sogs/ /bod kyis sbyar ba'i mdo sde yin/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar rnying la'ang*/ /bod kyis sbyar ba'i rgyud sde mang*/ /de 'dra'i rang bzo'i mdo rgyud la/ /mkhas pas yid rton mi bya'o/ /gtsug tor nag mo la sogs pa// bod kyi lha 'dres sbyar ba yod/ /'phral gyi byin rlabs cung zad 'byung*/ /'on kyang tshad mar byar mi rung*/ /lha mo gnas mkhar la sogs pa/ /mu stegs byed kyi rgyud kyang yod/ /cung zad bden pa yod mod kyi/ /de la'ang lung du byar mi rung | | de yi 'thad pa rgyud bla mar/ /mgon po byams pas 'di skad gsungs// ma rig ldong pa'i mu stegs la'ang*/ /srin bu'i yi ge 'dra ba yi/ /cung zad bden pa yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang yid rton mi bya gsung*/ /ring bsrel dang ni thugs dang ljags/ /sku gzugs la sogs rus pa las/ /'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan cung zad dpyad/ /'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni/ /yon tan stobs kyis 'byung ba ste/ /lus can rnams kyi bsod nams rten/

/'byung khungs las byung rin chen 'dra/ /ring bsrel la la gdon gyis byed/ /la la 'byung bzhi'i stobs las 'byung*/ kha cig bstan la dga' ba'i lhas/ /dad par bya phyir sprul pa'ang srid | | deng sang ring bsrel phal che ba/ /brdzun mas byas pa'i ring bsrel yin | | des na rnam dbye mkhas pas dpyad/ /thugs ljags sku gzugs la sogs pa/ /'byung ba chos nas gsungs pa med/ /'on kyang de 'dra 'byung ba kun | | phal cher brdzun mas byas pa yin/ /gal te bden pa yin na yang*/ / lung rigs gnyis ka med pa'i phyir/ /bzang ngan gnyis kar lung bstan dka' | | nyi ma du ma shar ba dang*/ /mkha' la bu ga dod pa dang*/ /mtshan mo gzha' tshon 'byung ba dang*/ /lus la 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ /glo bur lha 'dre mthong ba dang*/ /gson po'i lus la brdzun med par/ /ring bsrel 'dzag pa la sogs pa/ /blun po rtags su byed mod kyi/ /mkhas pas 'di 'dra mthong gyur na | | bar chad rtags su shes par gyis/ /sku gzugs mchi ma 'dzag pa dang*/ / de bzhin gom pas 'gro ba dang*/ /gar byed pa dang skad 'byin dang*/ khrag gi char pa 'bab pa dang*/ /sa 'og bong bu'i sgra sgrogs dang*/ /dud 'gro mi skad smra ba sogs/ /blun po ngo mtshar skyed mod kyi/ /mkhas pas 'di 'dra mthong gyur na | | yul der dgra bo gzhan dag 'jug /yang na ltas ngan gzhan dag 'byung*// 'di 'dra'i rigs can gzhan mthong yang*/ /mkhas pa rnams la legs par dris | | de dag don la 'khrul pa yi/ /rnam par dbye ba mdo tsam yin/ /de nas tshig la 'khrul pa yi/ /rnam dbye cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bshad pa la/ /bzhi bcom drug ldan bshad pa dang*/ /glegs bam gyi ni bshad pa la/ /glegs shing glegs thag 'chad pa dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bshad pa la/ /lag pa'i sgra don 'chad pa dang*/ /ye shes kyi ni bshad pa la/ /gdod ma'i shes par 'chad pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor 'chad la sems rnal ma/ /rig pa 'byor ces 'chad pa dang*/

/rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la/ /dmag gi dpung du 'chad pa dang*/ /gtum mo'i sgra bshad rnam rtog ni/ /chos nyid gtum par 'chad pa dang*/ /glu yi sgra bshad byed pa la/ /sems can slu bar 'chad pa dang | | phur ma ri rab mnyam pa la/ /dri rab mnam par 'chad pa dang*/ / shākya'i bu mo go pā'i sgra/ /go ni sa yin pā yi sgra/ /'tsho ba'am skyong ba sogs la 'jug /des na bod skad sa 'tsho yin/ /de la go pā'i sgra bshad ni/ /rtogs pa'i don du bshad pa dang*/ /rgya skad ratna ke tu'i la/ /ke tu'i sgra ni dbal dang tog / du ba mjug rings sogs la 'jug /skad rnying rnams la dbal du yod/ / gsar bcad man chad tog tu bsgyur/ /des na 'bum las rin chen dbal/ / gsar bcad ky-is ni zhus pa yi/ /brgyad stong pa las rin chen tog /ces byar bsgyur ba mi shes par/ /rin chen dpal du bshad pa dang*/ /po ta la zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /bod skad du ni gru 'dzin yin/ /ri bo gru 'dzin zhes bya bar/ /bsgyur na bod la 'thad mod kyi/ /la las rgya skad sor bzhag nas/ /po ta la yi ri zhes bsgyur | | de la sgra bsgyur la la yis/ /ri sgra gong du phyung nas ni/ /ri po ta la zhes byar bsgyur/ /de don ma rtogs pa rnams kyis/ /ri bo ta lar bshad pa 'khrul | | 'khor gsum yongs dag ces bya ba/ /rgya skad du ni tri maṇḍal/ /pa ri shuddha zhes byar yod/ /tri ni gsum yin maṇḍal la/ /zhes bya bod skad dkyil 'khor yin/ /pa ri shuddha yongs dag pa/ /drang por bsgyur na dkyil 'khor gsum | | yongs su dag pa zhes byar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi sgra bsdus nas | | 'khor gsum yongs dag zhes byar bsgyur/ /de yi sgra don mi shes par// 'khor gsum g.yog tu 'chad pa 'khrul/ /rgya skad laṅka pū ri la/ /pū ri'i sgra ni grong khyer yin/ /bod skad laṅka'i grong khyer te/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling na yod || 'on kyang rgya skad ma shes par/

/pu rangs su ni 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad bi ma la mi tra/ /bod skad dri med bshes gnyen yin/ /de yi sgra don mi shes par/ / bye ma la dang mu tra'i sgra/ /phyag rgya yin par bshad pa dang*/ /rgya skad nā ro ta yi sgra | | bram ze'i rigs kyi bye brag yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan mi shes par/ /dka' ba spyad pas a na na/ /ro ru song zhes 'chad pa dang*/ /ti lo zhes bya til brdung yin | | de la trai lor 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad lū hi zhes bya ba/ /bod skad nya yi rgyu lto yin/ /de yi sgra don mi shes par/ /glu yi pa ru 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad ind+ra bhū ti ni/ /bod skad 'byung po'i dbang po yin/ /de yi sgra 'gyur mi shes par | | brgya byin byang chub tu 'chad dang*/ /rgya skad a ba dhū tī'i sgra/ /gnyis spangs sam ni kun 'dar yin/ /de la 'dod ster 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad do ha zhes bya ba/ /bod skad lhug pa'am ma bcos pa/ /zhes bya'i don la 'jug mod kyi | | de yi rgyu mtshan mi shes par/ /do ni gnyis yin ha dgod pa/ /gnyis la dgod par 'chad pa dang*/ /rgya skad dza ba zhes bya ba/ /me tog dmar po zhig la 'jug

| de yi brda don mi 'phrod par/ /byams pa'i mdza' bar 'chad pa sogs | | blun po rnams la legs legs 'dra/ /mkhas pas mthong na bzhad gad gnas/ /rgyu mtshan ci yi phyir zhe na/ /saṃ skṛ ta yi sgra don la/ /bshad du mi rung nyid phyir dang*/ /rgya skad yin par mi shes par/ /bod skad yin par bshad phyir ro/ /des na de 'dra'i bshad pa kun/ /bod kyi blun pos sbyar bas na/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis dor bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bshad pa ni/ /de nyid rtogs par 'chad pa dang*/ /dgra bcom sgra don mchod 'os dang*/ /rgyal po'i bshad pa gsal ba dang*/ /bzod pa'i bshad pa mi 'byed dang*/ /phung po phrag par 'chad pa dang*/ khams la dbyings su 'chad pa dang*/ /bcom pa skal bar 'chad pa dang*/ /sbyang dka' thub dkar 'chad pa dang*/ /bag chags gnas su 'chad pa dang*/ /shākya phod par bshad pa sogs/ /bod la cung zad mi bde yang | | legs par sbyar ba'i sgra dag la/ /shin tu 'thad phyir mkhas pas blang | | sangs rgyas gsung rab dri ma med/ /bsdu ba dang po byas pa'i rjes/ / bstan pa dag par gnas pa na/ /yangs pa can gyi dge slong gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /mi rung ba yi gzhi bcu byas/ /de la 'phags pa bdun brgya yis/ /chos log legs par sun dbyung phy-ir/ /bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad ces grag /de ltar dag par byas pa'i rjes/ /lha chen zhes bya'i dge slong zhig/bstan pa 'di yi chom rkun byung*/ /de yis rang gi pha ma bsad/ /slob dpon yin pa'i dgra bcom bkrongs/ /mkhan slob med pa'i dge slong byas/ /phyi nas dgon par bsdad nas ni/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyi dad rdzas zos/ /blun po rnams kyi mkhan slob byas/ /blun po longs spyod can rnams kyis/ /phul ba'i zas nor char bzhin bab/ /skal med dad can 'dus pa yi/ /dge 'dun 'bum phrag du mas bskor/ /de nas brdzun rlabs chen po de/ /dgra bcom yin par khas blangs so/ /'khor gyis rdzu 'phrul zhus pa na/

/rdzu 'phrul tho rangs nyams zhes zer/ /rang gi sdig pa dran pa yis/ /smre sngags chen po bton pa la/ /sdug bsngal bden pa bos zhes bsgrags/ /de la sogs pa'i brdzun tshig gis/ / tshogs pa rnams kyi mgo bo bskor/ /'phags pa rnams la 'bul rgyu yi/ /dad rdzas rnams kyang de la 'gyur/ /rab byung blun po phal cher gyis/ /dgra bcom bor nas de la 'dus/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /so sor skyai bos 'khor bsdus pa/ /de las mang ba med ces grags/ /de yi chos log bshad pa yi | | rjes su slob ma rnams 'brangs nas/ /'khrul pa'i grub mtha' du ma byung*// lha chen blun po de shi nas/ /sems can dmyal bar gyur ces grag /de yi log pa'i chos de dag /dgra bcom rnams kyis sun phyung nas/ /bsdu ba gsum pa byas zhes thos/ /'on kyang de yi le lan gyis/ /sde pa bco brgyad rnams la yang | | cung zad bslad pa yod ces zer/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gnyen gyis/ /yang dag bsdus pa'i gzhi nyams phyir/ /mtha' dag min par rtogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yang de la dgongs/ /de ni nyan thos rnams kyi yin | | theg pa chen po'i bstan pa ni/ /shin tu dar bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma bsgrub pa'i mu stegs byed/ /sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis/ /gtsug lag khang rnams bsregs pa'i tshe/ /dam chos mngon pa la sogs pa/ /sde snod phal cher bsregs zhes grag /de nas 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ /mi pham mgon la gsan nas ni/ /de yi gzhung lugs dar bar mdzad/ /de yi rjes la mkhas pa dang | | blun po rnams kyi bye brag gis/ /bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib du ma byung*/ / phyi nas gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa legs par bsgyur/ /de nas bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs/ /de rjes chos log du ma 'phel/ /de tshe bla ma ye shes 'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog / rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/

/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i | | mkhas pa de yis sngon med pa'i/ /chos rnams phal cher bsgyur cing zhus | | chos dang chos min rnam 'byed pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni | | chos log thams cad nub par mdzad/ /de yi slob ma zhi ba 'od/ /des kyang sngags log sun 'byin pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad ces zer/ /de dag 'das pa'i 'og tu yang*/ /chos log 'ga' zhig 'phel ba'i rgyus/ /lhas btsas zhes bya'i lo tsā ba/ /des kyang chos log sun 'byin pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni/ /chos dang chos min rnam par phye/ /de nas chos rje sa skya pa | | chen po bzhugs pa yan chad du/ /chos log spyod pa nyung zhes thos/ /phyi nas phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sems bskyed rmi lam ma la sogs/ /yi dam bsgom pa dkrongs bskyed dang*/ /dkar po chig thub la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos log du ma deng sang 'phel/ /mkhas rnams 'di la mi dgyes kyang*/ /dus kyis shugs kyis bzlog ma nus/ /blun po sbyangs pa chung ba rnams/ /'di 'dra spyod pa bden mod kyi/ /mkhas pa sbyangs par rlom pa yang | | ri bong cal bzhin 'di la spyod/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can 'phel gyur na | | sangs rgyas bstan la gnod mi gnod/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod la smros | | gal te 'di 'dra'i chos log gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mi gnod na// mu stegs sogs kyi chos log kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la ci ste gnod/ /chos log gzhan gyis gnod na ni/ /'di dag gis kyang mi gnod dam/ /gnod kyang sun 'byin mi 'thad na/ /mu stegs byed dang nyan thos sogs/ /'di la'ang sun dbyung ci ste bya/ /'di dag bstan la gnod pa'i phyir/ /mkhas rnams sun 'byin mdzad na ni/ /bstan la gnod pa'i chos log kyang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis sun phyung shig /ci phyir zhe na rgyal ba yis/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni/ /rtag tu 'tshe ba mang zhes gsungs/

/'di la bsams la mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i byi dor bya/ /nyi ma gcig gi bza' btung la'ang*/ /bzang ngan rtogs dpyod sna tshogs gtong*/ /gos dang mkhar lhan la sogs pa'i/ /bya ba gang la'ang legs nyes dang*/ /bzang ngan mkhas dang mi mkhas zhes/ /blangs dor rtog dpyod sna tshogs byed/ /rta dang nor bu la sogs pa/ /cung zad tsam gyi nyo tshong la'ang*/ /kun la 'dri zhing brtags nas dpyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang | | de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong*/ /skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ / dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang*/ /chos 'di khy-i yi zas bzhin du/ /bzang ngan gang du'ang mi dpyod par/ /gang phrad de la gus par 'dzin/ /nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma'am/ /tshe gcig gi ni gnyen 'brel la'ang*/ /'bad dai brtags nas len pa mthong*/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don/ /bla ma mchog la rag las mod/ /'on kyang rtog dpyod mi byed par/ / tshong dus ngan pa'i zong bzhin du/ /su phrad rnams las len pa mthong*/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ /'bad mi dgos la 'bad pa byed/ /'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni/ /ci yang rung bas tshim par snang*/ /bdag ni sems can kun la byams/ /gang zag kun la bdag mi smod/ /brgya la mnyam par ma bzhag pas | | smad pa srid na'ang sdig de bshags/ /dam chos 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba | | skye ba gtan gyi gros yin pas/ /'di yi legs nyes dpyod pa la/ /sdang zhes smra na rang skyon yin/ /klu sgrub dang ni dbyig gnyen dang*/ /phyogs kyi glang po chos grags sogs/ /mkhas pa kun gyis rang gzhan gyi/ /chos log thams cad sun phyung ba/ /de la'ang sdang zhes zer ram ci/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang | | bdud dang mu stegs sun phyung ba/ /de yang phrag dog nyid 'gyur ram | | mkhas rnams blun po'i long khrid yin/ /nor ba'i chos dang ma nor ba'i | | long khrid legs par byas pa la/

/sdang zhes smra na da slan chad/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar bsrung*/ /long khrid kyis ni long ba la/ /g.yang sa bkag cing lam bzang por/ khrid pa'ang phrag dog yin nam ci/ /'o na long ba ji ltar bkri | | nad pa la ni gnod pa yi/ kha zas spongs shig phan pa bsten/ /de skad sman pas smra na yang*/ /sdang dang phrag dog 'gyur na ni/ /'o na nad pa ji ltar gso | | chos log pa dang ma log pa'i/ /rnam par dbye ba byas pa la/ /sdang dang phrag dog yin zer na/ /'o na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can rnams ni ji ltar bsgral/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa dang*/ /mkhas rnams bshad pa byed pa la/ /'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi lugs yin/ /ma khol gyis kyang 'di skad gsungs/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa ni | | mu stegs thams cad skrag mdzad cing*/ /bdud ni sems khong chud mdzad la | | lha dang mi rnams dbugs kyang 'byin/ /zhes gsungs deng sang 'di na yang | | mkhas pa rnams kyis chos bshad na/ /chos log spyod pa pham byed cing || bdud rigs thams cad yi mug 'gyur/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di 'dras bstan pa 'dzin par nus/ /'di las bzlog pa byung gyur na | | bstan la gnod par shes par gyis/ /bdag kyang rdo rje phag mo yi/ /byin rlabs tsam re byas pa la/ /dkar po chig thub bstan nas kyang*/ /myong ba cung zad skyes pa la/ /mthong lam du ni ngo sprad nas/ /rtsol bsgrub med pa'i don bstan na/ /tshogs pa'ang 'di bas mang ba 'du/ /longs spyod 'bul ba'ang mang bar 'gyur/ /blun po rnams kyi bsam pa la'ang*/ /sangs rgyas lta bur mos pa skye | | chos kyi gnad rnams mi shes pa'i/ /sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yang*/ /de la lhag par dad 'gyur bar/ /bdag gis legs par go mod kyi/ /'khor dang zang zing bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis sems can bsdus pa min/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /phan par bsams nas bshad pa yin/

/sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin bsgrubs na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan par bsams/ /mu stegs byed dang nyan thos dang*/ /theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig la'ang*/ /'khrul pa yod mod mkhas rnams kyis/ /sun phyung phyir na 'dir ma bshad/ /deng sang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rigs pas bsgrubs par mi nus shing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /'khrul pa gsar pa du ma byung*/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gnad 'chugs pas/ /rgyud sde rnams dang grub thob kyi/ /dgongs pa rnams dang 'gal ba'i gnad/ /dpag med yod mod gsang sngags nyid/ /yin phyir kho bos gzhan du bshad/ /'di ni kun la bshad rung ba'i/ /'khrul pa rags rim ci rigs pa | | 'phel na bstan la gnod mthong nas/ /che long tsam zhig bshad pa yin// da dung 'khrul pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /skyon can dpag med snang na yang*/ /gzhung mangs dogs pas re zhig bzhag /gal te lung dang rigs pa'i gnad/ /shes pa'i blo can rnams kyis de/ /legs par dpyod la dgag bsgrub gy-is/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang phrad dka' zhing*/ /dal ba 'byor pa'ang rnyed dka' bas/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis legs rtogs la/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis dpyod/ / bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma bslabs/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor rnams kyang shes/ /rgyan dang mngon brjod phal cher go /'dul ba dang ni mngon pa dang*/ /pha rol phyin pa'ang phal cher thos/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi po yang*/ /nyan bshad yod pa phal cher thos/ /thos pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ /ming rkyang tsam du ma bzhag go|bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /sems tsam dang ni dbu ma yi/ /gdams ngag ji snyed phal cher thos/ /deng sang bod la grags pa yi/ /zhi byed rdzogs chen gcod la sogs/ /skabs brgyad cig car bsgom pa dang*/ /pha rol phyin pa'i blo sbyong dang | | bka' gdams gdams ngag lugs gnyis dang*/ /sa ra ha dang ti lo pa | | nag po spyaud pa'i do ha dang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i/ /do ha seng ge zhes bya sogs/

/do ha'i bye brag du ma thos/ /rim lnga stan thog gcig pa dang | | nā ro chos drug lugs gsum dang*/ /gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs || de bzhin 'phags skor gdams ngag dang*/ /dgyes pa rdo rje snying po'i skor | | gshin rje gshegs dang 'jigs byed sogs/ /de yi gdams ngag gsar rnying dang*/ /'khor lo sdaum pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug sogs/ /mtshan brjod bshad pa lugs drug dang*/ /'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ /lam 'bras la sogs lam bskor dgu /de las 'phros pa du ma dang*/ /gzhan yang bod dang rgya gar la/ /deng sang grags pa phal mo che/ /bdag gis 'bad de legs par mnyan/ /bslabs pa de dag ming rkyang min | | de phyir chos rnams phal cher thos/ /des na bdag la phyogs lhung med// de phyir gzu bos dpyad pa 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyis 'di ltar zung*/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /log lta'i mun nag tshang tshing rnam par gsal | | blo gsal blo yi padma kha 'byed pa/ /bstan bcos nyi ma'i snang ba deng 'dir shar/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin zhes/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas bdag gis bshad/ /mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin mod/ / da dung blun po rnams kyis rtogs par dka'/ /kun dga'i nyi mas sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ /padmo rnam par phye ba las byung ba'i/ /dam pa'i sbrang rtsis 'gro ba'i bung ba kun/ /rgyun du bde ba'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /log pa'i chos rnams spangs nas kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang legs sprod pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma de la 'dud/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ mang du thos pa'i nor dang ldan pa/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa dpyod par nus pa'i blo gros can/ sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so//

// bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi gnad gtan la dbab pa gsang chen yin pas kho bos logs su bshad par blta'o/ / ༵ ( 'di la dpe bsdur lu phu la med la zha lu'i dpe la mchan bu yod pas de kha skong nang yod pas der dpe bsdur byas yod/ / ) chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 90PAGE 91
